TARGETED BACKGROUND EDIT of attached portrait 1024x1536. Preserve the approved MAIN SUBJECT EXACTLY: same mature Guan Yu face and green headwrap, same elaborate green/gold armor, same giant blue dragon, same enormous jade crescent blade and sweeping energy, same two gripping hands, same RED HARE fire mane and EXTREMELY HUGE FORESHORTENED FOREHOOF punching toward camera. The giant foreground hoof is intentional and loved: DO NOT shrink or normalize it. Keep same fantastical anime-mythic hero rendering and dramatic perspective. Do not change rider/horse pose or expression.
CHANGE ONLY THE WORLD BEHIND AND BELOW THEM: remove ALL floating islands, celestial palaces, levitating fortress fragments, cosmic voids, endless cloud seas, upside-down architecture, floating circular realm portals. Replace with GROUNDED ancient Chinese mountain-pass battlefield: an actual rocky dirt road beneath the galloping/leaping horse, rugged terrestrial mountain slopes, solid stone fortress gate connected to earth behind, small organized ranks of spearmen and plain red banners flanking the distant gate. Far mountains recede with atmospheric depth, dramatic clouds in SKY ONLY, not a floating cloud world. Keep stylized deep blue/teal shadows and warm gold light, powerful green/blue supernatural dragon and blade effects, but all architecture rests on land. Flying ROCK CHIPS from impact may remain; no floating buildings or islands. Rider/horse may leap off the ground with their existing huge foreshortening.
HARD INVARIANTS: physical metal blade shaft must remain a SINGLE perfectly straight traceable axis from pommel through both hands to blade socket; no offset, kink, fork, or second head. Fingers remain natural grasp, horse limbs connected coherently, no extra limbs. Curve only energy, never metal shaft. Keep full face unobscured and top safe margin. No text frame stars UI. No gore. Existing card frame not part of this pure artwork and must not be added.
